Greetings, Agents! 

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

A war against the Serpent, Odin’s brother 
who gains power from the fear of mankind, has begun!
Meet the Fear Itself related Super Villains 
through the August MARVEL Future Fight Update!
 
Four new Uniforms and four new Artifacts will be added for 
Hulk, Juggernaut, Titania, and Absorbing Man!
Hulk, the Breaker of Worlds, will advance to Tier-4!
Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential will be added for 
Juggernaut, Titania, and Absorbing Man!

 

Also, a new boss will be added for the Updated Heroes to challenge!
Prepare to battle the god butcher at World Boss Legend: Gorr.

 

In addition, the Biometrics lock feature and Material Fusion improvements 
will be added for our Agents to manage their materials more effectively.
Please check out the details below.

 

▣ Four New Uniforms

 

Fear Itself themed Uniforms will be added. 


* New Uniform Skills are based on the following skill Level stats. (Tier-4 heroes: Lv. 10, Others: Lv. 6)    
* The four new Uniforms will be on a 40% off discount during the <New Update Celebration Event!> 

and can be purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the event. 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Juggernaut, Titania, and Absorbing Man Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential will be added for 
Juggernaut, Titania, and Absorbing Man through the August Update! 
 

 

 

 


▣ Hulk Tier-4 Advancement & Striker Skill

 

Hulk will advance to Tier-4 and gain a new Striker Skill.
Check out the powerful abilities of the Breaker of Worlds.
* The Striker Skill stats are based on skill level 6.

 

 

▣ World Boss Legend: Gorr Release & Partial Improvements   

 

Prepare to fight against Gorr the god butcher who has been released 
from Legendary Battle as a threatening enemy in World Boss!

 

1. Gorr will be released as World Boss Legend.
- The World Boss ranking list for Gorr will be added.
- Challenges for Gorr will be added.

 

 

2. World Boss Legend: Gorr can be progressed from difficulty 1 after completing the challenges.
- Clear Story stage 8-3
- Own three or more heroes above Tier-3 or Potential transcendence
- Clear World Boss Challenges
① Clear World Boss Legend: Knull 5 times  
② Clear World Boss Legend: Mephisto 5 times  
③ Clear World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron 5 times  

 

 


3. Clear the new World Boss Legend: Gorr to acquire various rewards.  
- Search for Potential points, Tier-2, 3, and 4 advance materials, 
C.T.P., Conquer Level points, and other rewards will be given.
* The acquisition of Cosmic Cube Fragments is guaranteed when clearing World Boss Legend: Gorr.
* The Mighty C.T.P. of Judgment can be acquired at a low chance when clearing World Boss Legend: Gorr.    
* The Special Icon <The Necrosword> will be given 

upon clearing Gorr Legend  IV: difficulty 10 for the first time.

 

 
4. Improvements have been made to World Boss Legend: Infinity Ultron.  
- The duration of the Reality Stone (Red) attack 
that is used during the normal battle phase has been slightly decreased.
- The spinning speed of the Time Stone (Green) attack that is used 
towards the heroes during the normal optimization mode has been slightly decreased.
- The issue of heroes sometimes being moved 
with the Mind Stone (Yellow) attack has been improved.
- The issue of the display being awkward due to the motion of some effects 
not being displayed when set to use the lowest graphics option has been improved.
- The issue of the Time Warp status being retained when your hero succeeds in removing the optimization mode at the same time as being hit during optimization mode has been improved.

 

▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive passive skill Artifacts will be added for 
Hulk, Juggernaut, Titania, and Absorbing Man after the update.
* The Artifact Skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Season & Special Icons
 

A new season of Future Pass will start after the update.
Obtain various rewards along with Special Icons with the Future Pass!


[Future Pass Rewards]

- Please note that the Future Pass effects will apply 
immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Opened Legendary / Mythic Future Pass will only be applied during the season the Pass 
was purchased, and the Pass rewards will only be available during the same season. 
Please don’t forget to check the remaining event time!
- The Mythic Pass can only be purchased after purchasing the Legendary Pass.
- Legendary and Mythic Future Pass will not be available for purchase 
when the season is about to end. Please check the sale period in the game.


​New Special Icons have been added for our Agents!
Collect two new icons as Future Pass Rewards, one as the World Boss Legend reward, 
and one more from the upcoming Event!


[August Update New Special Icon]

          


▣ One New Uniform Collection

 

Check out the new Uniforms from the August Update!
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward!

 

 

▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. A feature to dismantle acquired Artifacts automatically when purchasing Artifact Chests will be added.
- Agents can select the target rank of Artifacts to be automatically dismantled. 
- The following type of Artifacts can be automatically dismantled.
   1★ - 6★ Artifacts and Exclusive Artifacts
- When purchasing Artifacts, the acquired target Artifacts will automatically 
be exchanged for Celestial Essence based on the [Automatic Dismantle Setting].

 

 

2. The item lock feature will be added to Inventory > Rank Up Material.
- A feature to possess specific Biometrics safely by locking Rank Up Materials will be added.
- When using Rank Up Materials for upgrading the level of heroes,
Agents can automatically select Rank Up Materials to be used with the Auto Select feature.
* When locking Rank Up Materials, Biometrics that have been locked 
will not be selected when using the auto select feature.

 

 

3. The Auto Enhance / Auto Combine function that can automatically combine items of 
the desired rank from lower grades when enhancing materials with rank will be added.
* The Auto Enhance or Auto Combine feature can be used for the following items:
Black Matter, Cosmic Cube Fragment, Type Enhancement Kit, and Dimension Rift Summon Stone

 

 

 

4. The Relay Upgrade feature that can upgrade Comic Cards of the higher rank 
right away when upgrading all Comic Cards will be added.
Ex) When upgrading all 3★ Comic Cards, 5★ Comic Cards can be upgraded 
if you do not possess 4★ upgrade materials but possess enough 5★ upgrade materials.
* The Relay Upgrade menu will not be displayed when upgrade materials are not enough.
* Locked Comic Cards will not be used as a material when upgrading all Comic Cards.

 

 

5. A system to view the Event Tokens that have been acquired since 2015 will be added.
- The term [S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive] in the main menu will be changed to [Archive]
and the Event Token Archive will be added as a subcategory.
- The Event Token Archive will be sorted based on the year of distribution, 
and the “In progress” label will be displayed for Event Token Archives of current events.
- The Event Tokens will automatically be collected at the Archive once achieved.
- Event Tokens that have been acquired in the past will also be automatically added 
to the Event Token Archive even if you do not currently possess the Event Tokens.

 

 


6. A pop-up screen informing that Alliance Points can no longer be gained through Alliance Donation 

will be added when the accumulated Alliance Points have reached the maximum limit.

 

7. The effects of some heroes have been improved not to be seen when the 

[Settings] - [Optimize Graphics In Real-Time Battle] option is turned on.

 

8. The issue of being able to conquer non-adjacent areas in Alliance Battle 
using airplane mode of the player’s device has been improved.
- The battle will be counted as a loss when a specific amount of time passes 
without being connected to the network during battle.

 

9. The effects of some heroes have been improved not to be seen
when the [Settings] - [Graphics] is set to [Very Low].

 

10. Improvements will be made so that the level of the skill information will be shown 
on the skill tooltip that is displayed when touching the skill icon in the Marvel Universe.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. The issue of the ice effects not being displayed as intended in the 
preview skill pop-up screen of [Uniform Room] - [Changed Skills] in iOS has been fixed. 
     
2.  The issue of the skill effect not disappearing and being shown 
on the results screen after the end of the stage has been fixed.
 
3. The issue of the Potential Awakening Skill being displayed as 
the Ultimate Skill in the Marvel Universe has been fixed.


4. The issue of the amount of damage that exceeds a certain amount 
being displayed as “-” in the Multiverse Invasion ranking page has been fixed.


5. The issue of the component information of the chests 
not being displayed in the Shadowland reward information has been fixed.


6. The issue of the Dimension Rift stage not being entered due to low Energy 
when entering with low Energy and waiting until enough Energy has been charged has been fixed.


7. The intermittent issue of the size of the boss becoming smaller 
in certain phases of World Boss Legend: Mephisto has been fixed.


8. The issue of letters being displayed backwards on objects 
in certain Multiverse Invasion stages has been fixed. 

 

9. The issue of the Tier-2 achievement of Sersi, [Mistress of Illusions], 
not being completed under certain circumstances has been fixed.

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.

 

Thank you.

​
